item.title: FDA rejects Summit's ivonescimab lung cancer drug after trial misses survival endpoint
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has issued a complete response letter to Summit Therapeutics, declining to approve its experimental lung cancer drug ivonescimab for patients with previously treated, EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, Summit announced on Sunday. item.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week
